title: Coding Guidelines
summary: Binding coding rules for dimuli contributors covering layers, Rust, Slint, Kotlin/Android, tests, dependencies, docs, and git.
notes: Prescriptive style and process rules, not an ADR (no Status/Decision/Consequences structure), not a PRD (no user stories or acceptance criteria), and not a SPEC (no endpoint, schema, or protocol contracts). Closest fit is DOC (guide-style, context only), but it is normative, so the synthesizer may want to treat its rules as conventions rather than context. Hash suffix could not be computed: no shell or hashing tool available to this classifier, so the file is written as CODING-GUIDELINES-NOHASH.json and must be renamed to CODING-GUIDELINES-<first 8 hex of SHA-256 of the POSIX source path>.json by the orchestrator.
